name: al-agentic-dev
description: Agentic AL/Business Central development — composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-mutate, al-research) with two persistent layers: repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (architecture.md + tasks.md). Replaces complex multi-agent workflows with focused single-purpose skills, standard BC vocabulary, and KISS/YAGNI principles.
